text:
sam: Heads up — appset rollout to gpu-pool-prod is stuck in 'Creating' for ~45m. Argo app-of-apps isn't progressing and we're seeing a steady stream of backoffs. Anyone oncall? :eyes:

jess: seeing it too. nodes scaled but pods are Pending. PVCs stuck in WaitForFirstConsumer and CSI binder errors in events.

leo: quick look — kube-scheduler is rejecting some pods due to taint mismatch. terraform change last night added a custom taint to gpu pool (key=reserved:gpu). Could be env drift.

anika: i pushed an AppSet tweak earlier (parallelism: 30) to speed rollout; worried that flooded kube-apiserver and Argo started backoff. i can revert if that helps.

sam: can someone paste the events / argocd status? i tried `argocd app sync --prune` but it errors on API rate limit and a few child apps have finalizers.

jess: here are the relevant bits:
```
$ kubectl get events -n gpu-prod | tail -n 8
2026-03-18T12:10:22Z Warning FailedBinding pvc-dbd3  persistentvolume-controller failed to bind volume: storageclass "custom-fast" provisioning failed: CSI: error attaching
2026-03-18T12:11:05Z Warning FailedScheduling pod/gpu-trainer-0  0/12 nodes are available: 4 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate, 3 node(s) had insufficient memory, 5 node(s) volume node affinity conflict
2026-03-18T12:12:01Z Warning BackOff  pod/argocd-repo-server  Back-off pulling image
2026-03-18T12:29:40Z Warning FailedSync app/my-models  kubernetes API rate limited
```
```

leo: that matches. terraform rename of taint key -> pods without new tolerations fail to schedule. PVCs also depend on node topology, and storageclass was switched to `custom-fast` in a commit linked from infra-ci.

anika: ok i'm reverting the AppSet parallelism from 30 -> 5 now (patching live). will re-trigger sync after. small change applied.

sam: i ran `argocd app sync gpu-pool-prod --prune --cascade` and got blocked by finalizers on child apps; infra-bot returned 429 on the API.

infra-bot: {"status":"warning","msg":"ArgoCD API rate limit hit; backing off syncs. See /ops/rate-limits"}

jess: short-term unblocks: 1) reduce AppSet parallelism (done), 2) add toleration to helm chart for the `reserved:gpu` taint, 3) ask storage team to revert the storageclass reclaim policy change.

storage-oncall: we're reverting the reclaimPolicy/volumeBindingMode on `custom-fast` to match gp3; ETA ~30m.

anika: also removed a stale finalizer from app `legacy-ml` (`kubectl patch app legacy-ml -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge`) — that let argocd prune proceed for a few children.

leo: I'll open a terraform PR to rename the taint back to the standard key and add a changelog. but for now, adding tolerations in the charts is cheaper. I'm pushing a quick helm patch.

ops-bot: deploy job started: helm upgrade --install gpu-models -f values-prod.yaml --set tolerations[0].key=reserved --set tolerations[0].operator=Exists --set tolerations[0].effect=NoSchedule

infra-bot: argocd sync status: succeeded for 18/23 apps; 5 pending (3 PVC binding, 2 awaiting node scheduling). continuing to watch.

sam: great. cc @security — note for postmortem: combination of terraform taint change + AppSet high parallelism created a thundering herd. add preflight checks to CI and a gate on AppSet parallelism. :pray:

jess: created ticket INFRA-324: "Prevent AppSet thundering herd — preflight and rollout gating" (https://redwood.company/infra/INFRA-324)

sam: thanks. leaving monitoring on this — will sudo a final sync once storage team confirms revert.

storage-oncall: storage revert completed, CSI reported successful provisioning for 4 PVCs.

jess: re-sync finished cleanly. all apps healthy in gpu-pool-prod.

leo: postmortem note: make AppSet parallelism default 5 and add a terraform lint rule to block taint key renames without rollout plan.

sam: agreed. closing thread but will follow up on INFRA-324. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
